messages_content_chk.name: messages_content_chk
messages_content_chk.value: "app"."messages"."deleted_at" is not null or ("app"."messages"."kind" = 'text' and "app"."messages"."body" is not null and char_length(btrim("app"."messages"."body")) > 0) or ("app"."messages"."kind" = 'image' and "app"."messages"."image_file_id" is not null) or ("app"."messages"."kind" = 'system' and "app"."messages"."body" is not null)

reports_resolved_chk.name: reports_resolved_chk
reports_resolved_chk.value: "app"."reports"."status" not in ('resolved','dismissed') or ("app"."reports"."resolved_at" is not null and "app"."reports"."action" is not null)

rooms_direct_key_canonical_chk.name: rooms_direct_key_canonical_chk
rooms_direct_key_canonical_chk.value: "app"."rooms"."direct_key" is null or ("app"."rooms"."direct_key" ~ '^[0-9a-f-]{36}:[0-9a-f-]{36}$' and split_part("app"."rooms"."direct_key", ':', 1) < split_part("app"."rooms"."direct_key", ':', 2))

rooms_name_chk.name: rooms_name_chk
rooms_name_chk.value: "app"."rooms"."kind" = 'direct' or ("app"."rooms"."name" is not null and char_length(btrim("app"."rooms"."name")) between 1 and 80)

posts_announced_chk.name: posts_announced_chk
posts_announced_chk.value: "app"."posts"."announced_at" is null or "app"."posts"."published_at" is not null

events_checkin_chk.name: events_checkin_chk
events_checkin_chk.value: ("app"."events"."checkin_opens_at" is null and "app"."events"."checkin_closes_at" is null) or ("app"."events"."checkin_opens_at" is not null and "app"."events"."checkin_closes_at" > "app"."events"."checkin_opens_at")

tickets_checked_in_chk.name: tickets_checked_in_chk
tickets_checked_in_chk.value: "app"."tickets"."checked_in_at" is null or "app"."tickets"."qr_code" is not null

tickets_cancelled_chk.name: tickets_cancelled_chk
tickets_cancelled_chk.value: "app"."tickets"."status" <> 'cancelled' or ("app"."tickets"."cancelled_at" is not null and "app"."tickets"."cancelled_by" is not null)

admins_invite_chk.name: admins_invite_chk
admins_invite_chk.value: ("app"."admins"."invite_token_hash" is null) = ("app"."admins"."invite_expires_at" is null) and ("app"."admins"."invite_token_hash" is null or "app"."admins"."status" = 'invited')

alumni_class_chk.name: alumni_class_chk
alumni_class_chk.value: "app"."alumni"."class_in" between 1 and 6 and "app"."alumni"."class_out" between 1 and 6 and "app"."alumni"."class_out" >= "app"."alumni"."class_in"

alumni_member_number_chk.name: alumni_member_number_chk
alumni_member_number_chk.value: ("app"."alumni"."member_seq" is null and "app"."alumni"."member_number" is null) or ("app"."alumni"."member_seq" >= 1 and "app"."alumni"."member_number" = lpad("app"."alumni"."cohort"::text, 2, '0') || '.' || (case when "app"."alumni"."class_in" <= 3 and "app"."alumni"."class_out" = 6 then '01' when ("app"."alumni"."class_in" <= 3 and "app"."alumni"."class_out" >= 3) or "app"."alumni"."class_out" = 6 then '02' else '03' end) || '.' || (case when "app"."alumni"."gender" = 'male' then '01' else '02' end) || '.' || "app"."alumni"."member_seq"::text)

alumni_period_chk.name: alumni_period_chk
alumni_period_chk.value: ("app"."alumni"."starts_at" is null) = ("app"."alumni"."expires_at" is null) and ("app"."alumni"."expires_at" is null or "app"."alumni"."expires_at" > "app"."alumni"."starts_at")

membership_events_period_chk.name: membership_events_period_chk
membership_events_period_chk.value: "app"."membership_events"."kind" not in ('activation','renewal') or ("app"."membership_events"."after_starts_at" is not null and "app"."membership_events"."after_expires_at" > "app"."membership_events"."after_starts_at")

membership_events_correction_chk.name: membership_events_correction_chk
membership_events_correction_chk.value: "app"."membership_events"."kind" <> 'number_correction' or ("app"."membership_events"."before_member_number" is not null and "app"."membership_events"."after_member_number" is not null)

membership_events_warn_chk.name: membership_events_warn_chk
membership_events_warn_chk.value: "app"."membership_events"."kind" <> 'warn' or ("app"."membership_events"."after_starts_at" is null and "app"."membership_events"."after_expires_at" is null)

payment_events_proof_chk.name: payment_events_proof_chk
payment_events_proof_chk.value: "app"."payment_events"."kind" not in ('proof_submitted','proof_replaced') or ("app"."payment_events"."proof_version" >= 1 and "app"."payment_events"."proof_file_id" is not null)

payment_events_rejected_chk.name: payment_events_rejected_chk
payment_events_rejected_chk.value: "app"."payment_events"."kind" <> 'rejected' or ("app"."payment_events"."reason" is not null and btrim("app"."payment_events"."reason") <> '')

payments_rejected_chk.name: payments_rejected_chk
payments_rejected_chk.value: "app"."payments"."status" <> 'rejected' or ("app"."payments"."decided_at" is not null and "app"."payments"."rejection_reason" is not null and btrim("app"."payments"."rejection_reason") <> '')

files_dimensions_chk.name: files_dimensions_chk
files_dimensions_chk.value: ("app"."files"."width" is null or "app"."files"."width" > 0) and ("app"."files"."height" is null or "app"."files"."height" > 0)
